blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Terrafirma kept its slim quarterfinal hopes alive in the PBA Governors’ Cup after blowing out guest team Macau, 146-127, on Saturday at Ynares Center here. Import Justin Strings, Juami Tiongson, rookies Geo Chiu and JM Bravo and Maverick Ahanmisi conspired in giving the Dyip a much-needed win that came after being handed a 22-point beating by the TNT Tropang 5G. The result enabled Terrafirma to go 4-6 with two games left, but is in a situation where it no longer holds control of its own playoff destiny.
